# 12-tone equal temperament

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tuningSystem12EDO`](gmeow-tuningSystem12EDO.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tuningSystem12EDO>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The Western common-practice equal division of the octave into 12 semitones. One [`TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md) among many ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
